summary: FedEx Corp filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement on 2026-09-11 for a $2.0B senior notes offering split into $1.1B of 4.000% notes due 2030 and $900M of 4.625% notes due 2034, guaranteed by FedEx Office, Federal Express International, Federal Express Holdings S.A., Federal Express Europe and Federal Express Corp. Interest pays annually each September 30 from 2026; notes carry optional make-whole redemption, tax redemption, change-of-control repurchase at 101%, and no sinking fund. This is an ordinary investment-grade debt takedown off an existing shelf, not a special situation; watch pricing spreads and leverage.
